# Datalyze

> Datalyze is an analytics & growth partner for startups. We rebuild your data
> foundation, then surface the growth your data has been hiding. Proven across
> 150+ Seed–Series C SaaS, marketplace, e-commerce, and fintech teams.
> Founded by Ansh Agrawal (https://www.linkedin.com/in/anshagrawal/).

## Core pages
- [Homepage](https://www.joindatalyze.com/): What Datalyze does and who it's for.
- [Pricing](https://www.joindatalyze.com/pricing): What an engagement costs - audits from $1k, infra setup $1.5k–$3k, embedded retainers $2k–$5k/month.
- [How it works](https://www.joindatalyze.com/how-it-works): The four phases of an engagement - foundation, unification, visibility, compounding.
- [AI Analytics Agent](https://www.joindatalyze.com/ai-analytics-agent): Our AI agent that answers product/growth questions on your own data.
- [Case Studies](https://www.joindatalyze.com/case-studies): Quantified client outcomes (CRED, Copyfy, VideoTap, FRAI, and more).
- [FAQs](https://www.joindatalyze.com/faqs): Pricing, team, engagement model, and what to expect.
- [Contact](https://www.joindatalyze.com/contact): Book a free 30-minute analytics audit.
- [About](https://www.joindatalyze.com/about): About the founder, Ansh Agrawal, and how we work.

## Free tools
- [Tools hub](https://www.joindatalyze.com/tools)
- [Analytics Maturity Grader](https://www.joindatalyze.com/tools/analytics-maturity-grader): 2-minute quiz scoring your analytics maturity across 5 dimensions.
- [Analytics Strategy Creator](https://www.joindatalyze.com/tools/analytics-strategy-creator): Free Claude skill that turns a product decision into an analytics strategy.
- [Event Tracking Plan Generator](https://www.joindatalyze.com/tools/event-tracking-plan-generator): Free Claude skill that generates a full event tracking plan.
- [Mixpanel Event Exporter](https://www.joindatalyze.com/tools/mixpanel-exporter): Free notebook that exports raw Mixpanel events to CSV.
- [Mixpanel Users Exporter](https://www.joindatalyze.com/tools/mixpanel-users-exporter): Free notebook that exports Mixpanel user profiles to CSV.
